title: feat(cutminopp): run f_cutmin from the opposite-corner 2-site seed
science: Carries a sharp methodological finding the series needs. From the opposite-corner seed S*={(0,0,0),(2,1,1)}, f_cutmin halts at 10 with history (2,8,10) - the SAME cardinality history as f_min - but the two stop on COMPLEMENTARY stuck pairs: f_cutmin is stuck on {(0,1,1),(2,0,0)} (permanently vertex3, three on-patch locks plus three off-patch unread slots), while f_min is stuck on {(1,0,1),(1,1,0)}
